r3.method: Bitshuffle HDF5 decoding and bounded actual-line spectral slices; a different MJD in same receiver is searched but does not equal a confirmed repeat.

r4.scope: 7 distinct source records covering 12 frozen groups
r4.method: Per-target HDF5 compressed chunk preflight, disk-backed range cache, fixed strongest-catalog-SNR representative line per group (middle index fallback), explicit partial scan status, deterministic contemporaneous other-target control and separate scan or different-day comparison if available.
r4.claim_ceiling: Archive slices alone are not detections or independent replicates.
r4.summary: All six accessible original and nearby other-target files read full 16 time rows; three repeat files cover eight groups. Three attempted different-day repeat files lacked coverage; Parkes file unresolved. Descriptive peaks also occur in control windows.

r5.method: Frozen R4 zip SHA256 and array SHA256 checks; row normalization; shifted-track reference; fixed corridor search around catalog drift; compare fixed-frequency and continuous extrapolated tracks against nearby control and same-session repeat. Synthetic recovery smoke. Scores descriptive, not calibrated p-values; no flux-calibrated sensitivity or barycentric independent repeat.

caveats: Robust shifted-track score is descriptive, not calibrated SNR or p-value. Search max selection not calibrated.
Fixed candidate line selected in R4; limited 1200 Hz window may clip fast drifting signals.
Nearby different target is not verified beam OFF; no absolute flux sensitivity comparison.
Different-day comparison at same topocentric frequency is not barycentric re-detection.
No new observations or independent experimental confirmation.

r6.method: All ten frozen catalog hits from three held groups; expanded ±6500 Hz windows; start-time anchor with midpoint/end diagnostics; two nearby control directions and matched same-session/different-day comparisons when present; normalized injected-track sensitivity checks.

limitations: All catalog hits tested; post-selection data, not independent blind detections.

Normalized injection is algorithm sensitivity only, not flux calibration.
